title: Prevent batch script from closing automatically on exit/error and verify installed rustup targets
commitMessage: fix(build): prevent auto-close on error/exit and check installed rustup target
author: agent-developer (Level 1 Subagent)

sensors.frontend_build_pnpm: pass (pnpm run build exit 0 in root)

summary: Fixed erroneous GNU target fallback when link.exe is not in PATH by strictly checking installed rustup targets (rustup target list --installed) in build-release.bat and build-release.ps1, preserving default host target (MSVC) when x86_64-pc-windows-gnu is not installed. Made pause enabled by default on completion and error exits so interactive console windows do not close immediately, added --no-pause flag for automated scripts and CI, added defensive pre-copy of WebView2Loader.dll into target release directory prior to tauri build.
